assets.name: nouka
assets.notes: nouka.ts frame: keel bottom y=0, gunwale y=0.42 amidships, ends sweep to y~1.2, L 4.6 m, beam 1.24 m, bow +Z; chhoi at z=+0.45; paddler seat bench at z=-1.0 y=0.36. Meshes hull/chhoi/benches. Paddle = boitha.glb

assets.name: boitha
assets.notes: paddle: blade tip at origin, blade 0.3 m, shaft along +Y, total 1.5 m

assets.name: launch
assets.notes: MV Sundarban: 30 m two-deck launch, waterline y=0, bow +Z, main deck y=2.0, upper deck y=4.51, roof deck y=6.75. Child node `flag` (origin at the hoist on the stern mast, cloth extends to -Z, 10x6 grid) waves in the game. Name painted on the hull (both bows and the transom, alpha-masked lettering, no boards); red boot-top / dark anti-fouling at the waterline; small fenders at deck-edge height.

assets.name: jetty_plank_segment
assets.notes: 2.2 m wide x 2 m deck piece; origin at deck top centre; posts (pair at z=0) reach y=-2. Chain every 2 m along Z.

assets.name: jetty_end
assets.notes: end piece (2.2 x 2 m) with mooring post, rope coil and ladder at +Z; origin deck top centre, attach after the last segment

assets.name: rope_rail
assets.notes: 2 m rail piece: one post at z=-1 (foot 0.35 below deck) and a sagging rope to z=+1; place along the deck edge every 2 m, add one extra post at the end

assets.name: rope_bridge_piece
assets.notes: 2 m rope bridge piece, walkway 1.2 m wide, hand ropes at y=0.95; origin at the deck top centre; chain every 2 m along Z

assets.name: plank_house
